newsitem.title: CHINA: China earthquake kills seven, injures over 10.
newsitem.headline: China earthquake kills seven, injures over 10.

text.p: A moderate earthquake on Tuesday in China's westernmost Xinjiang region has killed at least seven people and injured more than 10, officials said.

The earthquake measured at least 6.6 on the open-ended Richter scale, and not 6.4 as earlier reported, said an official of the local seismological bureau in the town of Jiashi, near the epicentre of Tuesday's tremor.
The number of casualties could rise as rescue teams and officials searched through rubble of collapsed houses in the farming district around the town of Jiashi, the official said.
"We will know more later in the day as we get reports from outlying districts," he said by telephone.
The earthquake rocked the district at 9.47 a.m. (0147 GMT) on Tuesday, state television said. An unknown number of houses had collapsed and cracks had appeared in others, it said.
